hero.label: Private Driver · Prague
hero.intro: Hire a car with a private driver in Prague for as long as you need: a few hours in the city, a full day out to Kutná Hora or Český Krumlov, a business day of meetings, or several days across Central Europe. A Mercedes and a professional driver stay at your disposal, from €{hourlyFrom} per hour.

paragraphs: A transfer takes you from A to B for a fixed price: the airport to your hotel, Prague to Vienna. The driver drops you off and the booking ends. It is the right choice when you know exactly where you are going and when.

A private driver is different. You book time, not a single journey. The car and the driver stay with you, wait while you are inside, and go wherever the day takes you — three meetings, a lunch that runs long, a stop nobody planned.
Prestigo offers both, with the same cars and the same drivers. This page is about the second: hiring a driver in Prague by the hour, for a day, or for a trip of several days.

items.title: By the hour in Prague
items.body: From €{hourlyFrom}/hour in an E-Class, €{hourlyV}/hour in a V-Class and €{hourlyS}/hour in an S-Class, with a 2-hour minimum. Good for an evening out, shopping or a slow tour of the city.

items.title: Day trips out of Prague
items.body: Kutná Hora, Karlovy Vary, Český Krumlov or Dresden in a single day. The driver waits while you visit and brings you back when you are ready.

items.title: A business day
items.body: Several meetings in different parts of the city, with the car waiting outside each one. Your bags stay in the boot and the next address is already set.

items.title: Several days across Central Europe
items.body: A multi-day trip — Prague, Vienna, Salzburg, Munich or Budapest — with the same car and driver throughout. Plan it at /book/multi-day.

items.title: A driver who knows the city
items.body: Which streets are closed to cars, where the car can wait, how to reach a hotel in the Old Town without circling. You do not need to know any of it.

items.title: Plans that can change
items.body: Add a stop, swap the order, stay longer. Tell your driver on the day; extra hours are added at the same rate.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking a driver in four steps.

items.title: Tell us the plan
items.body: Choose hourly hire, a day trip or a multi-day trip, and give the start time and pickup address. A rough outline of the day is enough.

items.title: Choose the car
items.body: E-Class for up to three, S-Class for an executive day, V-Class for up to six with luggage. You see the price before you pay.

items.title: Meet your driver
items.body: You receive the driver’s name and phone number in advance. They arrive at your address at the agreed time.

items.title: Use the time as you like
items.body: The car is yours for the booked hours. Change the order of stops or extend on the day by telling the driver.

editorial.label: What a private driver does
paragraphs: A good private driver does three things a map cannot. They wait — outside the meeting, near the restaurant, at the castle gate — so you never look for a car. They adapt — if the lunch runs late or the weather turns, the plan changes without a new booking. And they know Prague: the one-way streets, the pedestrian zones, the quickest way across the river at five in the afternoon.

Every driver speaks English, and Russian, German or Czech can be requested at booking. The cars are Mercedes E-Class, S-Class and V-Class, all under three years old, with Wi-Fi, water and a charger on board. Child seats are free on request.

If you only need a few hours inside the city, our city rides page covers hourly hire in detail. For a single trip to another city, a fixed-price route is often simpler. And if you are landing in Prague, an airport transfer gets you to the hotel first. Pick the shape of the day, and we will match the booking to it.

faqs.q: How much does a private driver in Prague cost?
faqs.a: Hourly hire starts at €{hourlyFrom} per hour in a Mercedes E-Class, €{hourlyV} in a V-Class and €{hourlyS} in an S-Class, with a 2-hour minimum. The rate is fixed at booking; there is no meter.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a transfer and hiring a driver?
faqs.a: A transfer is one journey from A to B at a fixed price. Hiring a driver books the car and driver for a period of time, so they wait for you and go wherever you need within those hours.

faqs.q: Can I hire a car with a driver for a day trip from Prague?
faqs.a: Yes. Popular day trips include Kutná Hora, Karlovy Vary, Český Krumlov and Dresden. The driver stays with you for the day and drives you back to Prague.

faqs.q: Can I book a driver for several days?
faqs.a: Yes. For trips across Central Europe over several days, book a multi-day journey at /book/multi-day and keep the same car and driver throughout.

faqs.q: What languages do your drivers speak?
faqs.a: All drivers speak English. Russian, German or Czech can be requested at booking.

faqs.q: Can I change the plan during the day?
faqs.a: Yes. Add stops, change the order or extend the booking by telling your driver. Extra time is charged at the same hourly rate.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Book online at least 12 hours ahead. For anything at shorter notice, call +420 725 986 855 — we operate 24/7.
